title: RoutePack: Expert Placement and Attention-Aware Data Packing for MoE Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.12146v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models for reinforcement learning (RL) couples two load-balancing problems: sequence composition determines dense attention work in each data-parallel microbatch, while token routing determines sparse expert work on expert-parallel ranks. Optimizing either alone can shift the bottleneck to the other. In MoE RL, rollout-time routing replay exposes every sample's sequence length and layer-wise expert demand before its training step. We present RoutePack, a hierarchical planner that coordinates state-consistent, layer-wise expert rerouting with joint attention- and expert-aware data packing over an optimizer-step window. RoutePack first places experts independently at each MoE layer using aggregate routing demand. translated_title: RoutePack：面向MoE强化学习的专家放置与注意力感知数据打包方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.12146v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：训练用于强化学习（RL）的混合专家（MoE）模型耦合了两个负载平衡问题：序列组合决定了每个数据并行微批次中的密集注意力工作，而令牌路由则决定了专家并行等级上的稀疏专家工作。单独优化其中任何一个都可能将瓶颈转移到另一个。在MoE强化学习中，推出时的路由重放在训练步骤之前暴露了每个样本的序列长度和逐层专家需求。我们提出了RoutePack，一种分层规划器，它在优化器步骤窗口内协调状态一致、逐层专家重路由与联合注意力和专家感知的数据打包。RoutePack首先使用聚合路由需求在每层MoE中独立放置专家。然后，它将样本打包成最小可验证的或最佳已知可行的、受令牌上限的执行行数，并使用投影EDP分片感知目标优化其DP布局。该目标...
tldr: RoutePack通过分层规划器同时优化MoE强化学习中的专家放置与数据打包，协调注意力与专家负载平衡，以最小化执行行数并提升训练效率。
en_tdlr: RoutePack is a hierarchical planner that jointly optimizes expert placement and data packing in MoE reinforcement learning, balancing attention and expert workloads to minimize execution rows and improve training efficiency.
